The '''Far Cradle''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that served as a refueling station for [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] forces in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] during the [[Galactic War]]. However, Imperial forces tracked short-range Republic fighters back to the station, and launched an [[Attack on the Far Cradle|attack]] that destroyed the station.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
